description: This file defines the FnStream class, which implements the StreamInterface to allow dynamic method composition based on provided function hashes, facilitating easy testing and extension of stream behavior.

classes.name: FnStream
classes.description: A class that composes stream implementations dynamically using a hash of functions, enabling flexible extension and testing of stream behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FnStream with a hash of method names to callables and dynamically creates corresponding properties.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Throws an exception if an unimplemented dynamic method is accessed.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Calls the close function if defined, on object destruction.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialization of the object by throwing a LogicException.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Creates a decorated stream instance, assigning default functions for missing methods.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the output of the __toString method or handles exceptions accordingly.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Calls the user-defined close function.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Calls and returns the result of the detach function.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream by invoking the corresponding function.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at the end.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream position.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Gets the remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information of the stream.
